summary: Parses a settings-style string beginning at a2+1 into tokens separated by delimiter 92 using StringTokenizer. For each accepted token i, reads the following token (or falls back to the default string byte_5EA438 when absent) and, when sub_564410(i) accepts the token, resolves a singleton object for each of the two values through SingletonGlobalAccessorWithFallbackAlloc on a1 and dispatches a two-argument call through the function pointer stored at a1+12 via FunctionPointerCallWithErrorHandling.

local_names.a1: owner/manager object whose +12 slot holds the dispatch function pointer
local_names.a2: buffer whose first byte is skipped; the token stream starts at a2+1
local_names.result: current token returned by StringTokenizer; loop terminates when null
local_names.v5: following token, or byte_5EA438 when absent
local_names.v7: dispatch function pointer read from a1+12
local_names.v8: two-element argument array passed to the dispatched call

operations.description: Begin parsing: StringTokenizer(a2 + 1, 92) returns the first token of the stream after the leading byte.
Iterate while the tokenizer returns a non-null token i; each iteration re-reads the next token and repeats until the tokenizer returns null.
Fetch the following token v5 with StringTokenizer(0, 92) using the continuation mode.
If the following token v5 is null, fall back to the default string byte_5EA438.
If sub_564410(i) is true for the current token, run the singleton-lookup and dispatch block.
Resolve the first argument: SingletonGlobalAccessorWithFallbackAlloc(a1, i) stored into v8[0].
Resolve the second argument: SingletonGlobalAccessorWithFallbackAlloc(a1, v5) stored into v8[1].
Read the dispatch function pointer v7 from (a1 + 12) on the owner object.
Invoke FunctionPointerCallWithErrorHandling(v7, v8) with the two resolved singleton values.
Advance the loop: result = StringTokenizer(0, 92); repeat while non-null.
Return the final tokenizer result (null at loop exit).
Shared helper invoked by sub_563AB0 and sub_564110 as a settings-style string parser.

unresolved: Semantics of the parsed tokens and of sub_564410's acceptance test are unknown; the prelabel marks this as a structural twin of SettingsFileInit (004b0930), suggesting settings-style key handling.

Owner object a1 and the meaning of the function pointer at a1+12 are unknown.
